correctness.rationale: A size-seven linear strong-AONT matrix over F_9 would, after normalization and discrete logarithms, give a CDPA(7,7;8). Exact symmetry-complete enumeration proves that no CDPA(5,7;8) exists, while an explicit CDPA(4,7;8) proves the supporting bound is sharp. The published six-by-six F_9 lower-bound matrix is separately verified by exact field arithmetic.

originality.rationale: Nasr Esfahani and Stinson explicitly leave 6 <= M_R([1,2],9) <= 7. Searches under AONT and difference-packing terminology found no later resolution or exact CDPA(5,7;8) nonexistence result. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with a stated residual access risk for Yin's 2004 and 2005 difference-packing papers.

value.rationale: The theorem closes a documented one-unit strong-AONT gap at q=9 and identifies an exact extremal cyclic difference-packing obstruction that explains the nonexistence.
